commit_roles.a949f9533ab8: clang-driver: clang/lib/Basic/Targets/RISCV.cpp only. getTargetDefines: '#define float16 _Float16' (when zhinx and (xpulpf16alt or xpulpfvec)) and '#define float16alt __bf16' (when xpulpf16alt); both on for -march=rv32imc_xgap9. handleTargetFeatures: HasFullBFloat16 = true under xpulpf16alt (per-operation bfloat16 rounding, no excess precision).

mechanism_choice: Predefined macros, not a predeclared typedef. GAP9 GCC treats the names as predeclared typedefs (shadowable), but a real implicit typedef needs Sema::Initialize (clang/lib/Sema/Sema.cpp, upstream file the fork does not touch, rule 11); TargetInfo can only add macros. For every SDK use (declarations, casts, sizeof, compound literals, vector_size typedefs in Emulation/Gap.h) both behave the same; grep of the SDK (outside gvsoc) finds no identifier use, no #ifdef test and no redundant typedef on a __gap9__ path. Design decision 6.4. Known corner cases: identifier reuse and a redundant 'typedef _Float16 float16;' become errors (hit by the gap9-sweep harness shim, see other_errors_seen).
bf16_rounding: HasFullBFloat16 under xpulpf16alt makes -fbfloat16-excess-precision=none behaviour the default (clang emits fadd/fmul bfloat, the backend still promotes each op to f32 and rounds through __truncsfbf2 until T3). This is the GCC-equivalent setting measured in the design (equals GCC -ffp-contract=off on every arithmetic numeq line). Same switch as upstream X86 (avx10.2-256, X86.cpp:309) and ARM (bf16, ARM.cpp:611). The -Xclang -fbfloat16-excess-precision=standard option no longer re-enables excess precision under xpulpf16alt (as on X86/ARM with full bf16).

vector_types: v2h/v2ah need nothing from T4: Gap.h builds them on float16/float16alt; accepted and compiled (scalarized to Zhinx / f32+__truncsfbf2). Native vfadd.h/vfmac.h etc. is T5; the v2h/v2ah builtins (f16abs2, f16max2, v2hftov2ohf, ...) are T6.
other_errors_seen: benchmarks/gap9-sweep/src/shim/at_api.h:11-13 does 'typedef _Float16 float16; typedef _Float16 float16alt;' under #ifdef __clang__; with -march=rv32imc_xgap9 the new macros turn it into 'typedef _Float16 _Float16' (error). Harness fix: '#if defined(__clang__) && !defined(float16)'. Not triggered by the sweep's own -march=rv32imc_zfinx_xpulpv2 flags.

Missing fp builtins now the first blocker for 89 of the remaining 94 float16 files: __builtin_pulp_f16abs2/f16altabs2 (77 files, used in inline functions of FastFloatApprox16.h, so every includer fails), f32max/min/abs/sqrt, f16(alt)max/min(2), f16(alt)sqrt, rintsf2, v2hftov2ohf, v2ohftov2hf (T6 / B97).
__bf16 arithmetic still links against compiler-rt __truncsfbf2 (GAP9 libgcc lacks it) until T3.
HasFullBFloat16 means -Xclang -fbfloat16-excess-precision=standard cannot restore once-per-expression rounding under xpulpf16alt (intended; same as X86/ARM).
